Eden Treaty options parameter for customization. fetch option: default RequestInit parameters. credentials, headers, signal. fetcher option: custom fetch function. Axios, unfetch alternatives. headers option: default HTTP headers. Function or object form. path-based conditional headers. Array of header functions. onRequest option: intercept before firing. Shallow merge of returned value. path parameter exclusion of hostname. requestInit parameters. Array form for multiple conditions. onResponse option: intercept response. New value return for transformation. Promise-based response modification. Array form for sequential processing. parseDate option: default true. Automatic date string to Date object conversion. throwHttpError option: default false. Automatic error throwing on non-2xx status. Boolean or function form for conditional throwing. Default headers configuration. headers object in options. X-Custom: 'Griseo' example. Shorthand for fetch.headers. Object or function form. path, options parameters to function. path starts with 'user' condition. Return object to append headers. Array of functions for multiple conditions. Header priority: inline method > config.headers > config.fetch.headers. Later array elements prioritized. Questions: How do I set default headers? Can I conditionally set headers? Headers priority in Eden Treaty. Inline method headers highest priority. config.headers secondary priority. config.fetch.headers lowest priority. Array order affects priority in config.headers. Later elements override earlier. Questions: How do I override headers? What's the priority order?

Request interception with onRequest. Intercept before fetch fires. Path parameter with hostname excluded (/user/griseo example). RequestInit options parameter. Return object to merge with request. Shallow merge for headers. Array form for multiple interceptors. All functions run even if value returned. Questions: How do I intercept requests? How do I add headers conditionally?

Response interception with onResponse. Intercept and modify response. Return new value to replace response. response.ok condition checking. response.json() for parsing. Response object parameter. Array form for sequential processing. Unlike headers/onRequest, stops at first returned value. Questions: How do I intercept responses? How do I parse response data?
Automatic date parsing. parseDate boolean option. Default true. Date string to Date object conversion. Automatic date transformation. Questions: Does Eden automatically parse dates?
